meta.name: G - single-sided ZOR liquidity, +50% to +200%
meta.description: Mints a ZOR-ONLY Uniswap V3 position at ticks 375480..382440. Both bounds sit below the current tick 386498, so it holds 100% ZOR and no USDG -- it costs the treasury nothing but idle tokens. It covers ZOR $0.0000245916..$0.0000491832, i.e. +50% to +200% above the current $0.0000163944, so it sits directly ABOVE batch H's band instead of overlapping it. As buyers push the price up this position sells ZOR to them and accumulates USDG, which is the point: the treasury holds 38,331,895 ZOR and $0.17 of USDG, and this converts idle supply into both trading depth and a stablecoin reserve. Adds roughly $838 of sell-side depth. Uses 10,000,000 ZOR (26% of the Safe's holding); together with batch H that is 22,366,688 committed and 15,965,207 left. amount0Desired is 0 -- no USDG is required or spent. TRADE-OFF: this sells ZOR into strength and so caps price appreciation. That is the intended exchange -- depth and a USDG reserve, in return for upside on tokens that are otherwise doing nothing.
